summary: Traces a TOP image or 2D POP field into contour lines, contour line strips, or triangle surfaces around pixels or sampled values that pass a threshold. Use it for 2D image-to-POP outlines, masks, and filled surfaces when threshold/channel choice, border handling, winding, smoothing, re-ranging, and GPU allocation limits matter.

key_params.name: inputattrscope
key_params.note: Attribute scope to sample when the input is a dimension-2 POP.

key_params.name: posattrib
key_params.note: Uses the P attribute to position threshold lines when sampling a dimension-2 POP input.

key_params.name: top
key_params.note: TOP image to sample and trace.

key_params.name: channel
key_params.note: Input channel used for threshold comparison: luminance, red, green, blue, alpha, RGB/RGBA average, or RGB/RGBA maximum.

key_params.name: resmult
key_params.note: Resolution multiplier applied to the input before tracing.

key_params.name: threshold
key_params.note: Threshold value that determines inside vs outside regions.

key_params.name: inside
key_params.note: Chooses whether below/equal-to-threshold or above-threshold values are considered inside; affects segment direction.

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Controls sampling outside the image boundary, such as Hold or Zero, to determine border contours.

key_params.name: twodimensions
key_params.note: Output mode: contour lines, contour line strips, or surface triangles.

key_params.name: uniquepoints
key_params.note: When outputting lines, chooses shared or unique points.

key_params.name: winding
key_params.note: Controls closed line-strip orientation, including natural outer-surface and hole winding.

key_params.name: smooth
key_params.note: Smooth Edge Distance control for averaging neighboring line-strip point positions.

key_params.name: filterdist
key_params.note: Smooth Edge Distance value component.

key_params.name: rerangep
key_params.note: Enables ReRange P for remapping output position coordinates.

key_params.name: tolow
key_params.note: Low target range for ReRange P in X and Y.

key_params.name: tolow0
key_params.note: X component of Map to Low.

key_params.name: tolow1
key_params.note: Y component of Map to Low.

key_params.name: tohigh
key_params.note: High target range for ReRange P in X and Y.

key_params.name: tohigh0
key_params.note: X component of Map to High.

key_params.name: tohigh1
key_params.note: Y component of Map to High.

key_params.name: normal
key_params.note: Outputs a Normal (N) attribute on points or primitives.

key_params.name: normaldirection
key_params.note: Chooses default or +Z normal direction.

key_params.name: texture
key_params.note: Outputs point texture coordinates (Tex).

key_params.name: allocfract
key_params.note: Fraction of maximum allocation reserved for generated points/primitives.

key_params.name: setmaxnumls
key_params.note: Enables an explicit Max Num Line Strips limit.

key_params.name: maxnumls
key_params.note: Maximum line-strip count for GPU preallocation.

key_params.name: setmaxnumvertsperls
key_params.note: Enables an explicit Max Num Verts per Line Strip limit.

key_params.name: maxnumvertsperls
key_params.note: Maximum vertices per line strip; helps prevent GPU infinite-loop conditions.

key_params.name: cpureadback
key_params.note: Copies topology count information from GPU back to CPU.

key_params.name: bypass
key_params.note: Common POP bypass flag.

key_params.name: freeextragpumem
key_params.note: Frees accumulated GPU memory after output sizes have grown and shrunk.

key_params.name: delinputattrs
key_params.note: Deletes input attributes that are not explicitly output, useful for isolating branches.

key_concepts: Max Num Verts per Line Strip
Copy Topology Info Back to CPU
common_gotchas: Max Num Line Strips and Max Num Verts per Line Strip must be pre-determined for the GPU to avoid overflows or pathological line-strip work.
Fraction of Max Allocation can save GPU memory, but if it is too low, points and primitives may be missing and the info popup may show maximum counts were reached.
Copy Topology Info Back to CPU causes a stall on discrete GPUs, so enable it only when CPU-side point/topology counts are worth the synchronization cost.
Extend changes border behavior: Hold can continue contours around the border while Zero can separate them as open line strips.
Winding affects holes: natural winding makes outer line strips counter-clockwise and enclosed line strips clockwise, while Counter ClockWise reverses hole orientation too.
Output mode matters: 2-point lines are the fastest but least useful form, line strips are contour-friendly, and surface triangles are needed for filled surfaces.
The default output P range is centered around P(0) -0.5 to 0.5; use ReRange P when downstream POPs or render setups expect a different coordinate range.
Smooth Edge Distance behaves like a line smoothing stage and can change vertex positions; verify outlines before using them for precise masks or topology.
